name: rosetta-pangram-checker
code:
use default

is_pangram(sentence: string) -> bool =>
    sentence
        |> map(char.to_lower)
        |> filter(char.is_letter)
        |> distinct()
        |> count() == 26

write_line("{is_pangram("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog")}")
write_line("{is_pangram("Hello, World!")}")
fullSource:
use default

is_pangram(sentence: string) -> bool =>
    sentence
        |> map(char.to_lower)
        |> filter(char.is_letter)
        |> distinct()
        |> count() == 26

write_line("{is_pangram("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog")}")
write_line("{is_pangram("Hello, World!")}")
